body:
Triage: lands in `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs` (`scanSource` + `selfTest`) → `domain:devx`, type Bug (the module's stated "cannot fabricate a lead" guarantee is measured false on 15 files today). Queued. The two missing self-test cases (nested template in `${…}`, escaped backtick) are part of the acceptance per the body. Serial note: #10453 and #10458 touch consumers of this module — the dispatching seat should sequence this fix first or declare non-overlap, and re-run the 16-file census after the fix as the verification. Size/model suggestion: M, opus.

Caught by the dev seat working #10595, which read the comments as instructed, found none, and said so instead of assuming. No competing claim existed on any of these, so no work was duplicated; the exposure was real regardless.
